title: kbgit.py sorts commits into content and code lanes
goal: kbgit.py lane [A..B] prints each commit with its lane: content when every path is under a kb root (kb/<root>/**), kb/_querylog/**, kb/_self/backlog/** or is _tools/aliases.csv; code otherwise, a commit touching both included; tests.py -k lane covers each boundary with a planted commit

gates.question: Which paths are the content lane (direct push)? Everything else is the code lane (merge request).
options: kb roots, kb/_querylog, kb/_self/backlog and _tools/aliases.csv (process docs in kb/_self/*.md go with the code they describe)
the same plus kb/_self/*.md process docs
kb roots only; backlog items and query-log data go through merge requests too
gates.recommendation: kb roots, kb/_self/backlog and _tools/aliases.csv (process docs in kb/_self/*.md go with the code they describe)
